{"metadata":{"description":"Self-contained power control for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar power button with upward restart/shutdown menu, Windows-shutdown-style overlay, own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins).","id":"gh:1334880263","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-power-button","slug":"keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button","topics":["client-plugin","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","power","restart","shutdown"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Self-contained power control for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar power button with upward restart/shutdown"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" menu, Windows-shutdown-style overlay, own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"enu, Windows-shutdown-style overlay, own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-power-button"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A self-contained **power & lifecycle controller** for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar power button with "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"a Restart / Shutdown menu and a full-screen transition overlay. The restart engine is built in — no "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"third-party dependencies."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Developed with DeepSeek AI assistance; reviewed before release."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Sidebar power button** in the footer action slot, theme-aware and styled to match the adjacent S"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ettings trigger.
- **Restart / Shutdown menu** with a Windows-style full-screen overlay; the page re"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"loads by itself after a confirmed restart.
- **Self-contained restart engine**: a detached `.cjs` he"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"lper takes over relaunching DSH through an ARM → COMMIT → ACK handshake, waits for the old process, "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"the port and the session logs, then relaunches the same invocation in the same cwd. A `--port 0` com"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"mand line is pinned to the port the old process actually bound. In the Desktop app the restart is ha"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"nded to Electron instead, when that app advertises a restart protocol. No PowerShell, no `taskkill`."},{"id":"p7s8","text":"
- **`/restart` and `/shutdown` commands**, a **`restart_harness` model tool** (registration is skip"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ped when another plugin already owns the name), and a read-only **`restart_status`** tool for checki"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ng whether a restart happened.
- **Localized UI and host notices** (zh / en), following the profile'"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"s `locale.preference`.
- **Startup housekeeping**: helper logs and scripts, per-restart handshake re"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"cords, and undelivered notices older than 7 days are pruned from the runtime directory."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**① Sidebar power button** — theme-aware footer entry."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**② Restart / Shutdown menu** — two actions, one click away."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**③ Shutdown confirm dialog** — the default focus sits on **Cancel**; only an explicit confirm stops"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"confirm dialog** — the default focus sits on **Cancel**; only an explicit confirm stops the process."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**④ Shutdown progress overlay** — shows the current stage while the process winds down."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**⑤ Restart completed toast** — after the auto reload, a notice confirms DSH is back."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart DSH; a power button appears in the sidebar footer. Requires Node ≥ 22.19."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Configured through the profile's cordis layer (`cordis.patch.yml` or the settings UI):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `enableModelTool` | `true` | Register the `restart_harness` model tool. Set `false` to keep restar"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"t on the GUI button and `/restart` only. |
| `maxDelayMs` | `5000` | Upper bound (ms) for the model "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"tool's `delayMs`. The effective floor is 1000 ms. |
| `restartWakeMode` | `quiet` | What the session"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" that asked for a restart is told afterwards. `quiet` stages the notice for its next step without wa"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"king anything; `notify` also wakes that session once it is live, so the model reports the restart wi"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"thout a user message. Neither mode restarts anything on its own. |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Restart is an explicit ARM → COMMIT → ACK handshake. The old process does not exit until a live help"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"er owns the relaunch; every failure before the ACK keeps the old process running. After spawning the"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" successor, the helper waits up to 180 seconds for readiness. The browser allows a five-minute polli"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ng budget for the full restart, including shutdown and preparation. A refused request remains an err"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"or even if later health probes fail."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Five invariants hold this together:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- The helper lives **outside the process tree** (`detached`, a real `.cjs` file — a multi-line `node"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" -e` is mangled by Windows `CreateProcess`), so terminating DSH cannot kill it mid-flight.
- Success"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" is confirmed by a per-process `instanceId` that must **change**, so a brief outage never fakes it.
"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"- The launcher's exit channel is read at `ctx.get('appExit')`, never as a property: it is an optiona"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"l host service this plugin does not inject, and a property read resolves to `undefined` — which woul"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"d skip graceful disposal and hard-kill instead.
- Exit is bounded end to end, and the bounds are **d"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"erived rather than duplicated**: graceful exit gets a 15 s watchdog, the pre-exit flush cap is 5 s, "},{"id":"p26s8","text":"and the helper's patience for the old PID is computed from both, so they cannot drift into the helpe"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"r giving up first.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Desktop"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The Desktop application runs the Host as a child of its Electron shell, so exiting that child invoke"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"s the app's crash recovery and replaying its command line yields a Host without a window or its orig"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"inal IPC channel. Two cases, decided by what the host advertises:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Host advertises a restart protocol** (`DSH_DESKTOP_RESTART_PROTOCOL` in the Host environment, IP"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"C channel connected): the plugin writes the restart marker, flushes live sessions, and asks the shel"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"l to restart; Electron owns the relaunch. If the shell does not take over within 20 seconds, the req"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"uest fails, the transition is released, and the button works again.
- **Host advertises nothing** (e"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"very released DeepSeek Harness so far): restart and shutdown are refused with `503` and `reason: "de"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"sktop-unsupported"`; no helper or exit is scheduled. Use the application's Quit menu or tray action,"},{"id":"p29s7","text":" then reopen it — closing the main window can leave the app running in the tray."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Making the first case available means changing DeepSeek Harness itself, which is outside this plugin"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"'s boundary; the steps are in `docs/desktop-restart-protocol.md`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Safety"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Destructive POSTs go through **the deployment's own browser-trust fence and authentication** via `"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ctx.connection.requestRejection` — the call the host's `/api` route uses. `/api/dsh-power-button/*` "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"is longer than the official `/api` prefix, so longest-prefix matching never routes these requests th"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"rough that fence; delegating keeps them under the operator's real policy, including LAN authorities "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"derived from an all-interface bind and any `trustedHosts` / `--trusted-host` declaration.
